subject: Exclusive Summer Sale Starts Tomorrow!
body: Dear valued customer, Get ready for our exclusive summer sale starting tomorrow! Enjoy up to 50% off on selected items and grab the hottest deals of the season. Don't miss out on this limited-time offer to update your wardrobe with the latest trends. Visit our store or shop online to take advantage of these amazing discounts. Hurry, while stocks last! Best regards, The Fashion Boutique Team
